explanation: Calculates the total fair value and percentage share of current fair value for each investment type across the entire panel using holdings_v.
sql: SELECT investment_type, SUM(fair_value) AS total_fair_value, SUM(fair_value) * 100.0 / (SELECT SUM(fair_value) FROM holdings_v) AS percentage FROM holdings_v GROUP BY investment_type ORDER BY total_fair_value DESC
